articles.title: Tetris3D: 3D Scene Generation With Objects That Fit Together
articles.content: We propose Tetris3D, a generative framework for single-image 3D scene reconstruction that recovers objects which are physically and geometrically coherent as a scene. Existing methods often generate objects independently or couple them implicitly, providing limited guidance for ensuring fine-grained spatial compatibility between neighboring objects that interact with one another. To address this, we explicitly condition the generation of each object on the geometry of surrounding objects and their physical relationships, guiding its shape and pose to remain geometrically and physically plausible within the scene. Moreover, we introduce ComOb, a physics simulation-based dataset of 1.2M scenes featuring physical interactions across diverse object categories, with per-object meshes and pairwise physical relation annotations. Comprehensive experiments on synthetic and realworld scenes show that Tetris3D recovers coherent object shapes and poses even when interacting regions are occluded, and achieves state-of-the-art performance in both generation quality and physical stability.

articles.title_zh: 方块3D: 三维场景生成, 具有匹配对象
articles.content_zh: 我们提出方块3D,作为单像3D场景重建的基因框架,回收物理和几何上一致的物体作为场景. 现有方法往往独立生成物体或隐含地与物体对接,为确保彼此相互作用的相邻物体之间的细纹空间兼容性提供了有限的指导. 为了解决这个问题,我们明确地将每个物体的产生以周围物体的几何及其物理关系作为条件,引导其形状和姿势保持几何和物理上可行的场景. 此外,我们引入了ComOb,一个物理学模拟数据集,由1.2M场景组成,以不同对象类别之间的物理相互作用为特征,并附有每个对象的网格和双向物理关系说明。 对合成和现实世界场景的全面实验表明,俄罗斯方块3D在相互作用区域被占据时,即使恢复了连贯的物体形状和姿势,并在生成质量和物理稳定性上都实现了最先进的性能.

articles.title: Never Look Back: Understanding Persistence in 3D Object Memory from Egocentric Videos
articles.content: As we move through the world and carry out everyday tasks, we encounter objects that may become relevant only later. We are capable of recalling where we left something or what was inside a container, even without knowing we would need it later. Here, we study how an embodied assistant can build a similar memory from egocentric videos, by observing a person's day-to-day activities. We present Ledger, a persistent 3D object memory that combines object locations, their histories, and contextual descriptions. It associates observations across the recording and retains objects after they leave the view, including those the person never touches. It clusters each object's observations by resting locations and records a move only after repeated evidence, reducing the effect of localization noise. Short descriptions preserve details such as an object's contents or supporting surface. It saves these records to later answer spatial questions without having to access the original images or video. Our memory raises HD-EPIC accuracy from 29.7% to 42.6%, UCS-Bench accuracy from 33.8% to 38.5% and localizes Ego4D objects with a 0.99 m median error on returned predictions. Our analyses identify complementary roles for temporal persistence, contextual descriptions, and retrieval. Our study on 100 stitched streams of multiple scenes each further exposes failures in both retrieval and construction. Per-scene construction partially recovers the performance lost across scene changes compared to that of single scene streams.

articles.title_zh: 永不回头:从Egocentral视频中了解3D对象内存中的持久性
articles.content_zh: 当我们穿越世界,执行日常任务时,我们遇到的物体可能只是后来才变得相关。 我们有能力回顾我们留下的东西或容器内的东西,即使不知道我们以后会需要它。 在这里,我们研究一个体现的助手如何通过观察一个人的日常活动,从以自我为中心的视频中建立类似的记忆. 我们介绍Ledger,一种持续的3D对象内存,结合对象位置,其历史,以及背景描述. 它将整个记录的观察联系起来,并在物体离开视野后保留这些物体,包括该人从未接触的物体。 它通过休息位置将每个物体的观察集合起来,只记录在反复证据之后的动作,降低本地化噪声的效果. 简短的描述保存细节,如物体的内容或支撑表面. 它保存这些记录,以便日后回答空间问题,而无需访问原始图像或视频. 我们的内存将HD-EPIC的精度从29.7%提升到42.6%,UCS-Bench的精度从33.8%提升到38.5%,并且将返回预测中误差0.99米的Ego4D对象本地化. 我们的分析确定了时间持久性、背景描述和检索的互补作用。 我们对100条缝合的多个场景流的研究,每条都进一步暴露了检索和构造方面的失败. 与单一场景流相比,场景构造部分恢复了场景变化中失去的性能.

articles.title: Long-WAM: Scaling the Context of World-Action Models
articles.content: Real-time robot control demands enough visual history to infer motion and task progress, but processing that history can delay action. We present Long-WAM, a model-system framework for scaling the context of causal world-action models under real-time control constraints. Our central finding is that access to history is not the same as using it: longer histories pay off far more when the video foundation is pretrained autoregressively (AR). We first learn causal prediction from robot and egocentric videos without action labels, then preserve this history-to-future structure during world-action adaptation. On RoboCasa GR-1, increasing context from 0.0 to 19.2 seconds raises success from 63.3% to 78.7%, whereas a bidirectionally pretrained initialization shows no net gain; robot-domain AR pretraining further raises peak success on GR-1 and LIBERO-Long. Long-WAM also achieves the best results among compared methods on LIBERO-Long, RoboTwin 2.0, and DOMINO. Streaming observation encoding, asynchronous execution, and hardware-specific acceleration enable deployment on RTX 5090, DGX Spark, and Jetson AGX Thor without dropping future prediction; on RTX 5090, each action chunk, including future-video latent prediction, takes 107.4 ms. Real-time deployment on Unitree G1 and YAM supports dynamic and long-horizon manipulation, including 95% success on dynamic cup stacking, where Pi0.5 and Fast-WAM succeed in none of 20 trials. As a memory-informed executor, Long-WAM also complements higher-level planning in composite tasks.

articles.title_zh: 长期行动计划:扩大世界行动模式的背景
articles.content_zh: 实时机器人控制需要足够的视觉历史来推断运动和任务进度,但处理这种历史可以延迟动作. 我们提出长WAM,这是在实时控制限制下扩大因果世界行动模型背景的模型系统框架. 我们的核心发现是,获取历史与使用历史并不相同:当视频基础事先经过自动训练(AR)时,较长的历史就能够产生更大的收益。 我们首先从没有动作标签的机器人和以自我为中心的视频中学习因果预测,然后在世界动作适应过程中保留这种历史到未来的结构. 在RoboCasa GR-1上,上下文从0.0升至19.2秒,成功率从63.3%升至78.7%,而双向预训初始化显示无净收益;机器人域AR预训进一步提升了GR-1和LIBERO-Long上的峰值成功率. Long-WAM在LIBERO-Long,RoboTwin 2.0和DOMINO的比较方法中也取得了最佳效果. 流线式观测编码、同步执行和硬件专用加速可以部署在RTX 5090、DGX Spark和Jetson AGX上 Thor没有放弃未来预测;在RTX 5090上,每个动作块,包括未来影视潜伏预测,需要107.4毫秒. 在Unitree G1和YAM上的实时部署支持动态和长视距操纵,包括动态杯堆叠成功95%,其中Pi0.5和Fast-WAM在20个试验中都没有成功. 作为内存知情的执行者,Long-WAM在复合任务中也补充了更高层次的规划.

articles.title: GRACE: Generation-aware latent compression for efficient video generation
articles.content: Highly compressed video autoencoders offer an effective way to accelerate video diffusion models, as the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) operates on far fewer tokens. However, such autoencoders are challenging to train, since a higher compression ratio degrades reconstruction quality and recovering it requires more channels, which is known to slow the convergence of the DiT. The compressed latent also differs from the one the DiT was trained on, so the pretrained DiT must be either retrained from scratch or adapted at considerable cost. Compressing the autoencoder the DiT was trained with appears to preserve compatibility, yet optimizing it for reconstruction alone still shifts the latent away from the distribution the DiT has learned. To address this, we propose Generation-Aware Latent Compression for Efficient Video Generation (GRACE), a two-stage framework that compresses a pretrained video autoencoder while keeping it compatible with the pretrained DiT. Specifically, we keep a frozen base latent from the pretrained encoder and learn a residual latent for the information lost under stronger compression, while aligning the compressed latent with the pretrained latent in the feature space of the frozen DiT so that the autoencoder is optimized for generation. We then adapt the DiT with lightweight fine-tuning and asymmetric denoising, where the base is denoised ahead of the residual. GRACE reduces the token count of Wan2.1-I2V-14B by 8x and its latency by 11.1x at 480x832x81, while matching the generation quality of the pretrained pipeline before compression on VBench.

articles.title_zh: GRACE:为高效的视频生成而进行世代意识潜在压缩
articles.content_zh: 高度压缩的视频自动编码器为加速视频传播模型提供了有效的方法,因为传播变形器(DIT)运行的代号要少得多. 然而,这种自动编码器在训练上面临挑战,因为更高的压缩比会降低重建质量,恢复它需要更多的通道,这已知会减缓DiT的汇合. 压缩的潜质也与DiT所训练的潜质不同,因此预训的DiT必须从头开始再训练,或以相当的代价进行改造. 压缩DiT所训练的自动编码器似乎保持了兼容性,但仅用于重建的优化仍转移了DiT所学到的分布的潜伏性. 为了解决这个问题,我们提议了“一代-智能Laten Compression for Executive Video Crowth”(GRACE),这是一个两阶段框架,它压缩一个预先训练的视频自动编码器,同时保持它与预先训练的DiT兼容. 具体地说,我们从预先训练的编码器中保持一个被冻结的底部潜伏,并且为在更强的压缩下丢失的信息学习一个残余的潜伏,同时将被压缩的底部与被冻结的DiT的特性空间中被预先训练的潜伏相配合,以便自动编码器能够优化生成. 然后我们用轻量级的微调和不对称的去诺化来改造DiT,在残基之前去诺化. GRACE将Wan2.1-I2V-14B的令牌计数减少8x,并在480x832x81时将其纬度减少11.1x,同时在压缩V Bench之前将预训管的生成质量相匹配.

articles.title: Video-Conditioned Generative Joint 2D-3D Hand Motion Recovery
articles.content: Recovering faithful 3D hand motion from video remains challenging due to frequent occlusions and incomplete visual observations, which make frame-wise pose estimates unreliable and temporally inconsistent. To address this problem, we propose JoHan, a unified generative framework that recovers hand motion directly from video sequences without relying on intermediate per-frame pose predictions. Trained from scratch, our model jointly generates aligned 2D and 3D local hand pose sequences by learning their temporal dynamics and cross-representation correspondence. The generated 2D trajectories exploit direct spatial and temporal cues from the 2D images to guide the following generative 3D motion reconstruction, while the learned motion prior promotes temporal consistency. Their learned 2D-3D correspondence further enables recovery of the hand's global position and orientation relative to the camera. Extensive experiments on challenging benchmarks demonstrate significantly improved accuracy and speed in local hand-pose and camera-space reconstruction. Notably, our method captures much better hand-motion dynamics, producing significantly smoother motion than previous methods while maintaining high per-frame pose accuracy.

articles.title_zh: 2D-3D型联合基因组 手动 恢复
articles.content_zh: 从视频中恢复忠实的3D手动仍然具有挑战性,因为经常被隐蔽和不完全的视觉观察,这使得帧式的估计不可靠,时间上也不一致. 为了解决这个问题,我们提议JoHan,一个统一的基因框架,它直接从视频序列中恢复手动,而不依赖于中间的每帧预测. 从零开始训练,我们的模型通过学习时间动态和交叉表示的函授,联合生成对齐的2D和3D本地手摆出序列. 生成的2D轨迹利用2D图像的直接空间和时间提示来引导以下基因的3D运动重建,而之前学到的运动则促进时间一致性. 他们所学的2D-3D通信进一步使手相对于相机的全球位置和方向恢复. 关于具有挑战性的基准的广泛试验表明,当地手提架和照相机空间重建的准确性和速度大大提高。 值得注意的是,我们的方法捕捉到的手动动力学要好得多,产生比以前的方法更加平滑的动作,同时保持高的每帧的精确度。

articles.title: QuadTok: Quadtree Visual Tokenizer for Autoregressive Image Generation
articles.content: We introduce QuadTok, a novel framework for visual tokenization and autoregressive image generation. Compared to traditional approaches using 2D grids or 1D token sequences, we propose a hierarchical quadtree structure, bridging the gap between 2D spatial binding and 1D sequence-level flexibility. The QuadTok tokenizer dynamically allocates representational capacity to visually intricate areas while leaving homogeneous regions at a coarse resolution. Compared with a fixed 256-token grid, our ImageNet-trained tokenizer saves approximately 10% of tokens on ImageNet and 9% when transferred zero-shot to the COCO dataset, while maintaining comparable reconstruction fidelity. Furthermore, the natural causality introduced by the tree structure seamlessly enables autoregressive image generation. Conditioned on a quadtree topology supplied before generation, our 947M GPT-style generative model achieves a 2.08 gFID on the ImageNet $256 \times 256$ benchmark. Additionally, leveraging the strong spatial correlation preserved by the quadtree structure, the QuadTok generator enables zero-shot spatially controlled image generation capabilities. Code: https://github.com/myc634/QuadTok.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: QuadTok: 自动图像生成的 Quadtree 视觉切除器
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍QuadTok, 视觉符号化和自动反向图像生成的新框架。 与使用2D网格或1D令牌序列的传统方法相比,我们提出了阶梯式的四树结构,弥合2D空间绑定和1D序列级灵活性之间的差距. QuadTok 标注器动态地将代表能力分配给视觉复杂领域,同时将同一区域置于粗糙的分辨率之下。 与固定的256个托肯网格相比,我们的ImageNet训练的代号器在ImageNet上节省了大约10%的代号,在将零射入COCO数据集时节省了9%,同时保持了可比较的重建忠诚度. 此外,树状结构引入的自然因果关系无缝地能够自动递归图像生成. 我们的947M GPT式基因模型在ImageNet上实现了2.08 gFID, 此外,利用四面体结构所保持的强烈空间相关性,QuadTok生成器使零镜头空间控制图像生成能力成为可能。 代码:https://github.com/myc634/QuadTok.

articles.title: Insights from Autoresearch for Solar Panel Segmentation
articles.content: This paper investigates AutoResearch, a protocol in which a coding language model edits a training program under a one-hour GPU budget and retains a change only if validation IoU improves. The protocol is applied to photovoltaic panel segmentation on a frozen real-image split, with DeepLabV3--ResNet-50 held fixed. Three campaigns of 24 experiments, using Gemma~4 12B, Qwen3-8B all improve their one-hour baselines, but retained modifications do not transfer across hardware. The Qwen3-8B configuration, trained on real images only, reaches a test IoU of 0.836 versus 0.833 for the reference GAN-augmented schedule. Research repository https://github.com/VU-AIML/automl4eo-autoresearch-segmentation.

articles.title_zh: 太阳能板块自动研究的透视
articles.content_zh: 本文调查 自动研究(AutoResearch),一种编码语言模型在1小时GPU预算下编辑培训程序,并且只有在验证IoU改进时才保留更改的协议. 协议适用于在冻结的真象分割上进行光伏面板分割,DeepLabV3-ResNet-50被固定. 使用Gemma~4 12B,Qune3-8B的三次24个实验运动都改善了他们的一小时基线,但保留的修改不会跨硬件传输. articles.title: Agentic RSR: Real-to-Sim-to-Real through Scene Reconstruction and Execution-Grounded Robot Policies
articles.content: A simulation of a real robot workspace must preserve task-relevant interactions, while policies developed in it must operate on observations available to the real robot. Yet scene reconstruction and policy development are often treated separately. We present Agentic Real-to-Sim-to-Real (Agentic RSR), a framework that links scene reconstruction, policy development, and real-robot execution through the same manipulation task. Given a workspace video, a task description, and a known robot model, an agent recovers metric scale, iteratively refines the scene using visual feedback, and checks task-relevant interactions in MuJoCo. A coding agent then develops an executable policy, progressing from privileged object poses to visual observations and randomized simulation. The policy can interleave multiple observations and actions within one invocation, while the agent uses execution feedback to continue, retry, or revise its approach. A shared task-level interface carries the policy and accumulated experience to the real robot, where fresh observations and safety checks guide execution. Across 18 reconstructed scenes involving two robots, the mean four-view Depth MAE against reference depth estimates is 0.1057 m, the mean Lab $ΔE_{76}$ is 11.04, and the mean grayscale SSIM is 0.6990. In real-robot experiments, the aggregate task success rate reaches 80% of the simulation task success rate, indicating substantial retention of simulated performance on hardware. Code and reconstructed scene data will be made publicly available.

articles.title_zh: 代理 RSR:通过场景重建与执行全方位机器人政策实现真实到真实
articles.content_zh: 对真正的机器人工作空间的模拟必须保持与任务相关的相互作用,而其中制定的政策必须运行在真正的机器人可用的观测上. 然而,现场重建和政策制定往往分开处理。 我们提出Agentic Real-to-Sim-to-Real(Agentic RSR),这个框架通过同样的操纵任务将现场重建,政策制定和真机器人执行联系起来. 鉴于一个工作空间视频,任务描述,以及已知的机器人模型,一个特工恢复了度量尺度,利用视觉反馈对场景进行迭代精细化,并检查了MuJoCo中与任务相关的互动. 然后,一个编码代理制定可执行政策,从特权对象的姿势发展到视觉观察和随机模拟。 该政策可以将多种意见和行动放在一种援引中,而代理人则利用执行反馈来继续、重复或修改其做法。 共享的任务级别接口将政策和积累的经验带给真正的机器人,在那里,新的观察和安全检查指导执行。 横跨18个涉及两个机器人的重建场景,平均四视深度MAE相对于参考深度估计为0.1057米,平均Lab $ΔE_{76}$为11.04,平均灰度SSIM为0.6990. 在真机器人实验中,总任务成功率达到模拟任务成功率的80%,表明在硬件上模拟性能的大量保留. 将公布代码和重建的场景数据。

articles.title: Label-free cell counting and viability prediction with brightfield imaging and deep learning
articles.content: Cell viability assessment is a core requirement in cell culture systems, with critical applications in biopharmaceutical manufacturing and drug development. Conventionally, it is measured by adding membrane-impermeable dyes to a sample (a process called staining), which allows compromised cell membranes to be distinguished from intact ones. However, staining has several limitations: (a) chemical agents can perturb normal cellular processes of the cells being measured, (b) it is often ambiguous to assign viability to individual cells whose membrane integrity is only partially compromised. (c) photobleaching can undermine measurement accuracy over time when using fluorescent stains, and (d) staining cannot be performed in situ or in real time. Here, we show that (1) stained cells captured under brightfield imaging contain sufficient information to distinguish live and dead cells, and (2) cells captured under unstained brightfield imaging exhibit similar image features to their stained counterparts, enabling models trained on stained cells to generalize to unstained ones. We then report the development and validation of ViabiLens, an AI-assisted software for label-free cell viability analysis. The ViabiLens combines a cell detection model for localizing individual cells with a convolutional neural network (CNN) classifier for live/dead prediction, paired with an interactive UMAP-based viewer for visualizing and exploring individual cells across the sample. Evaluated on Chinese Hamster Ovary (CHO) cells spanning a wide range of viability conditions, ViabiLens achieves a mean absolute error of 2.68\% on unstained samples against fluorescence-based reference measurements. We also release a benchmark dataset for label-free cell viability analysis to facilitate future research, available at https://amirrezavazifeh.github.io/ViabiLens-Project-Page/.

articles.title_zh: 无标签细胞计数和可行性预测,并配有亮场成像和深度学习
articles.content_zh: 细胞生存能力评估是细胞培养系统中的一项核心要求,在生物药物制造和药物开发中具有关键应用. 常规的测量方法是在样品中添加膜-不透膜染料(一种称为污渍的过程),这样可以将受损的细胞膜与完好无损的细胞膜区分开来. 然而,污渍有几种局限性:(a)化学剂可以扰动被测量细胞的正常细胞过程;(b)将生命力分配给膜完整性仅部分受损的单个细胞往往含糊不清. (c) 在使用荧光污点时,光裂会损害测量的准确性,(d) 污点不能就地或实时进行。 在这里,我们显示:(1) 在亮场成像下捕获的有污细胞含有足够的信息,可以区分活细胞和死细胞;(2) 在无污的亮场成像下捕获的细胞呈现出与其有污的对应物相似的图像特征,使受过有污细胞训练的模型能够概括为无污的细胞. 然后,我们报告ViabiLens的开发与验证情况,这是用于无标签细胞可行性分析的AI辅助软件. ViabiLens将单个细胞局部化的细胞检测模型与活性/死性预测的进化神经网络分类器(CNN)结合,与基于UMAP的交互式查看器配对,用于整个样本的可视化和探索单个细胞. ViabiLens对涵盖广泛生存条件的中国Hamster Ovary(CHO)细胞进行评估后, 我们还发布了无标签细胞生存能力分析的基准数据集,以便利今后的研究,可在https://amirrezavazifeh.github.io/ViabiLens-Project-Page/上查阅。

articles.title: MORCA: Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Cache Reuse in Video Diffusion Acceleration
articles.content: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) achieve remarkable performance in video synthesis, but their iterative denoising process suffers from high inference latency. To address this, caching has emerged as an effective acceleration strategy by capitalizing on inter-step redundancy during denoising. Existing dynamic caching methods typically estimate the error that cache reuse would introduce at each denoising step (step error) to guide cache decisions, whereas our concern is how much quality loss cache reuse would cause in the final generated video (terminal error). We show that step error does not directly correspond to terminal error and that latent information helps capture their relationship, thereby informing cache decisions. Moreover, existing threshold-based methods cannot provide precise speedup control, making it difficult to meet practical requirements for user-specified acceleration targets. To address these limitations, we introduce MORCA, a cache scheduling framework trained through offline-to-online reinforcement learning to make latent-aware reuse/recompute decisions under user-specified acceleration targets. Extensive experiments on different video generation models across multiple target acceleration ratios demonstrate that MORCA achieves better generation fidelity than state-of-the-art caching methods under comparable computational budgets. Code is available at https://github.com/x10ngyx/MORCA.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MORCA: 离线到在线的适应缓存强化学习
articles.content_zh: 扩散变形器(DiTs)在视频合成中取得了显著的性能,但是它们的迭代去诺过程受到高推论延迟的影响. 为了解决这一问题,通过利用去名期间的跨步骤冗余,缓存已成为一项有效的加速战略。 现有的动态缓存方法通常估计缓存再利用在每个解密步骤(步骤错误)会引入指导缓存决定的错误,而我们担心的是,在最终生成的视频中,质量损失缓存再利用将造成多少(最终错误). 我们显示步骤错误与终端错误并不直接对应,潜在信息有助于捕捉它们的关系,从而通知缓存决定. 此外,现有的基于阈值的方法不能提供精确的加速控制,因此难以满足用户指定加速目标的实际要求. 为解决这些局限性,我们引入了MORCA这一缓存调度框架,通过线下到线上强化学习加以培训,以便在用户指定的加速目标下作出潜在意识到的再利用/计算决定。 跨多个目标加速率的不同视频生成模型的广泛实验表明,MORCA在可比计算预算下比最先进的缓存方法更能实现生成忠诚。 代码见https://github.com/x10ngyx/MORCA.

articles.title: MemoCare: An Interactive Multimodal Mobile System for Automated Cognitive Screening
articles.content: MemoCare is an interactive mobile system for automated multimodal cognitive screening. A React Native application combines spoken responses, temporal and spatial orientation, touchscreen actions, and visuoconstruction in complete English and Vietnamese workflows. Speech is transcribed by Google Speech-to-Text and scored locally with deterministic task-specific natural language processing rules; GPS coordinates are resolved by the MemoCare spatial module before answer matching; touch tasks are scored from interaction events; and the drawing task uses a three-model convolutional neural network consensus with separate visual interpretation. Software tests pass 151/151 predefined cases across speech/language, spatial-answer, and touch-interaction scoring, while spatial regression passes 48/48 four-country coordinate-resolution cases. For the drawing module, validation-selected ShuffleNetV2 x1.5 achieved 91.33% mean balanced accuracy and 78.87% exact three-criterion accuracy on a locked 71-image test set. Four clinician co-authors additionally inspected the end-to-end workflow, yielding a pooled median rating of 4/5 across eight criteria, with item-level medians ranging from 3 to 4.5. At MMM, attendees can directly try a shortened multimodal screening workflow and inspect automatic item-level and total scoring.

articles.title_zh: 备忘录:自动认知筛选交互式多式联运系统
articles.content_zh: MemoCare是一个用于自动化多模式认知筛选的交互式移动系统. 反应原生应用程序结合了口语反应,时间和空间导向,触摸屏动作,以及完整英语和越南语工作流程的粘合. 语音由Google Speech-to-Text转录,并在当地用定型任务特定自然语言处理规则打分;GPS坐标在回答匹配前由MemoCare空间模块解决;触摸任务由交互事件打分;绘图任务使用三种模式的进化神经网络共识,分别进行视觉解释. 软件测试通过 151/151 预先定义的个案,跨越语音/语言,空间答案,和触摸交互评分,而空间回归则通过48/48 四国协调解例. 对于绘图模块,所选择的ShuffleNetV2 x1.5在锁定的71-图像测试集上实现了91.33%的平衡精度和78.87%的精确三标精度. 四名临床医生联合作者还检查了端到端的工作流程,得出了8项标准的4/5的集合中位数,项目水平中位数从3到4.5不等。 在MMM,参与者可以直接尝试缩短多式联运筛选工作流程,并检查自动项目级别和总评分.

articles.title: ECHO: Embodied Camera Observations of Human Object Carrying
articles.content: Embodied and assistive agents must do more than recognize objects: they must reason about where an object belongs given the layout of an environment and the habits of the people who live in it. Progress on this problem has been limited, in part because no dedicated benchmark or dataset exists to define and evaluate it. Existing RGB-D scan datasets reconstruct static rooms without human activity, while human-object-interaction datasets capture motion without a navigable, fully reconstructed scene or a ground-truth notion of an object's natural destination. We introduce contextual object placement as a benchmark task: predicting an object's destination during an observed object-carrying episode. To support this task, we present Embodied Camera observations of Human Object carrying (ECHO), a large-scale synthetic dataset that pairs dense RGB-D scans of indoor scenes with recordings of an embodied human carrying everyday objects to context-appropriate destinations. ECHO is the first publicly available dataset to combine reconstructed scenes, human activity, natural language, and contextual-placement annotations. It comprises 3,805 human-annotated episodes across 159 floors of 115 HM3D scenes, involving 198 distinct objects. Each floor includes a complete RGB-D scan with human-annotated room labels and a surface list. Each episode provides synchronized RGB-D encounter clips; 6-DoF camera, human, and object trajectories; start and destination surfaces; an action caption; and a human-written context: a single sentence describing the inhabitant's routine that implies the destination without naming it. We evaluate contextual object placement using input-masked probes and an end-to-end baseline. Results show that no single input modality is sufficient, highlighting the need to jointly reason over scene structure, human activity, and contextual knowledge.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ECHO: 人体物体携带的完整摄像头观测
articles.content_zh: 健美的辅助剂必须不止是识别物体:鉴于环境的布局以及生活在其中的人的习惯,它们必须说明物体属于何处。 在这个问题上的进展有限,部分原因是没有专门的基准或数据集来界定和评价。 现有的RGB-D扫描数据集在没有人类活动的情况下重建静态室,而人-对象交互数据集则在没有可导航,完全重建的场景或物体自然目的地的地面真实概念的情况下捕获运动. 我们引入了背景对象放置作为基准任务:在被观测到的物体载体插曲中预测物体的目的地. 为了支持这一任务,我们提出了人体物体携带体相机观测(ECHO),这是一个大规模合成数据集,将室内场景密集的RGB-D扫描与一个包含人类日常物品的录音配对到适合背景的目的地。 ECHO是第一个将重建的场景,人类活动,自然语言,以及背景定位说明相结合的公开数据集. 它包括3 805个人类附加说明的剧集,共有159个楼层115个HM3D场景,涉及198个不同的物体。 每层都包含一个完整的RGB-D扫描,带有人带说明的房间标签和一个表面列表. 每集提供同步的RGB-D相遇剪辑;6-DoF相机,人,和物体的轨迹;起始和目的地表面;动作标题;以及人文上下文:单句描述居民的日常,暗示目的地而不命名. 我们利用输入式扫描仪和端到端基线来评估背景物体的放置。 结果表明,没有一种单一输入模式是足够的,突出表明需要共同理性,而不是场景结构、人类活动和背景知识。

articles.title: Detecting Adversarial Images through Response Profiles of Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Adversarial perturbations can alter the predictions of frozen vision-language models (VLMs) while leaving their confidence and image--text similarity patterns seemingly plausible. We investigate whether we can identify adversarial inputs based on the broader way an image interacts with a collection of general semantic prompts. Our detector summarizes these responses using category-level statistics, relationships among prompts, deviations from clean reference distributions, and stability under weak image transformations, producing a compact response profile that is classified by a lightweight model while the VLM remains fixed. We evaluate the approach on multiple public image datasets, several CLIP-style visual backbones, and a range of gradient-based, optimization-based, automated, and spatial attacks. The detector achieves strong discrimination in attack-specific settings and retains substantial performance when evaluated on attacks not seen during training. Under a controlled detector-specific protocol, the response-profile representation outperforms the evaluated embedding-geometry baselines. Additional analyses show that the feature groups provide complementary information and that the method remains effective under variations in the prompt configuration. We also examine inference cost and performance against detector-aware adaptive attacks. Overall, the results indicate that response patterns across semantic prompts provide a useful complementary signal for adversarial image detection in frozen VLMs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 检测异常 通过视觉-语言模型的响应配置图像
articles.content_zh: 扭曲的扰动可以改变对冷冻的视觉语言模型(VLMs)的预测,同时使其信心和图像文本的相似性模式看起来是可信的。 我们调查是否能够根据图像与一般语义提示的集合互动的更广泛方式确定对抗性投入。 我们的探测器利用类别级统计、提示之间的关系、与清洁参考分布的偏差和图像变弱下的稳定性来总结这些响应,生成一个紧凑的响应剖面图,用轻量级模型分类,而VLM则保持不变。 我们评价多个公共图像数据集的方法,几个CLIP风格的视觉骨干,以及一系列基于梯度,优化,自动化和空间攻击. 探测器在针对具体攻击的环境下实现强烈歧视,并在对训练期间未见的攻击进行评价时保留相当的性能. 根据受控探测器特定协议,反应示意图的表示比评估的嵌入几何基线要好。 其他分析表明,专题小组提供补充信息,在即时配置的变化下,该方法仍然有效。 我们还审查探测器适应性攻击的推论成本和性能。 总体而言,结果表明,跨语义提示的反应模式为冷冻VLM中的对抗性图像探测提供了有用的补充信号.

articles.title: SGF+: Decoupling Gradient Flows for Autoregressive Video Generation
articles.content: Autoregressive video generation requires denoising the current frames while writing their key-value representations as context for future predictions. However, these two roles typically share parameters, and we find that their gradients exhibit distinct patterns and systematic negative alignment, hindering the joint optimization of visual quality and temporal consistency. We introduce Self Gradient Forcing Plus (SGF+), which assigns separate parameters to context writing and denoising while preserving their interaction through causal attention. Both roles are jointly optimized using the original generation objective without auxiliary losses, with context writing supervised through its contribution to future predictions. This simple change improves visual quality and long-horizon consistency over the evaluated baselines in both framewise and chunkwise generation, without additional video training data or a longer training horizon. Trained on only 5s rollouts, SGF+ supports continuous generation for up to 24 hours without long-video fine-tuning. These results highlight role-specific parameterization as an effective design principle for high-quality autoregressive video generation and native long-horizon extrapolation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SGF+:自动视频生成的渐变流
articles.content_zh: 自动递归式视频生成需要解析当前帧,同时写出其键值表示作为未来预测的背景. 然而,这两个角色通常都具有共同的参数,我们发现它们的梯度呈现出不同的规律和系统性的负对齐,阻碍了视觉质量和时间一致性的联合优化. 我们引入了自我渐变加号(SGF+),它指定了单独的参数来进行上下文书写和去名化,同时通过因果关注来保持它们的相互作用. 这两种角色都共同使用原生成目标进行优化,不附带损失,通过对未来预测的贡献来监督背景书写. 这一简单变化提高了视觉质量,提高了在框架和块状生成方面评价基线的长视野一致性,没有额外的视频培训数据或更长的培训视野。 SGF+只接受5s推出的训练,支持连续生成最多24小时,没有长视频微调. 这些成果凸显了角色特定参数化是高质量自递视频生成和本土长视距推断的有效设计原则.

articles.title: GraphRectify: Graph-Based Transfer of Adversarial Example Detectors Across Neural Networks
articles.content: Adversarial example detectors are often tied to the classifier backbone they were trained on, limiting reuse when the protected model is replaced or upgraded. Directly transferring such detectors across backbones is challenging because different networks generally produce incompatible internal representations. We propose GraphRectify, a graph-based framework for transferring adversarial image detectors across classifier backbones. GraphRectify learns a structured representation of intermediate classifier features and adapts representations from a new backbone to the detector learned on the original model, enabling detector reuse. We evaluate GraphRectify across multiple datasets, backbone architectures, and adversarial attacks, including detector-aware adaptive attacks that jointly target the classifier and detector. Across the complete evaluation matrix, GraphRectify achieves higher aggregate ROC-AUC than training a detector from scratch on the new backbone and the evaluated transfer ablations. The gains are particularly strong for transfers between different backbone families and when sufficient data are available. In contrast, training from scratch remains competitive in the most data-limited settings. These results show that adversarial detection knowledge can transfer effectively across heterogeneous classifier architectures rather than being relearned whenever the protected backbone changes.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 图校正: 以图为基础的横跨神经网络的横向示例检测器转移
articles.content_zh: 横向实例探测器往往与所训练的分类主干网相连,在被保护的模型被替换或升级时限制再利用。 将这种探测器直接跨越主干线具有挑战性,因为不同的网络通常产生不兼容的内部表述。 我们提议用图表校正,一个图表框架,将对抗性图像探测器传输到分类器主干线上。 GraphRecify学习了中间分类器特征的结构化表示,并将表示从一个新的主干线调整到原始模型上学到的探测器,使探测器能够再利用. 我们通过多个数据集、骨干架构和对抗攻击,包括联合针对分类器和探测器的探测器意识适应性攻击,来评估图形校正。 在完整的评价矩阵中,GraphRecify实现的汇总ROC-AUC比从头到尾在新主干线上培训探测器和经评估的转移堆积要高。 在不同骨干家庭之间以及在获得足够数据的情况下,收益特别大。 相比之下,在数据最有限的环境中,从零开始的培训仍然具有竞争力。 这些结果显示,对抗性的检测知识可以有效地跨越不同的分类结构,而不是在受保护的主干结构发生变化时被重新学习。

articles.title: Rubix: Global Correspondence-Free Point Set Alignment through Assignment Geometry
articles.content: Procrustes-Wasserstein alignment jointly estimates a matching and rotation without supplied correspondences, but alternating minimization can stop at suboptimal solutions. Rubix solves the equally weighted planar problem globally under squared Euclidean loss. Each matching $σ$ of two centered $n$-point sets defines a complex correlation $z_σ=\sum_i\bar x_i y_{σ(i)}$. Their convex hull is the permutation polygon: supporting vertices give optimal matchings at fixed rotations, and the farthest vertex gives the global alignment. We prove the sharp bound of $n(n-1)$ vertices for $n\ge2$, answering Rote's rotation-assignment open problem. In exact arithmetic, assignment queries recover the polygon in $\mathcal O(n^5)$ operations. Assignment-based bounds extend the approach to three-dimensional rotations and partial matching at a supplied translation through branch-and-bound. On timed MPEG-7 shape pairs, Rubix attains every numerical reference value in 12 ms on average, 50 times faster than a rotation grid at the same accuracy. Its distances improve gravity-aligned matching of real 3D scans, shape retrieval and noisy crystal classification over alternating minimization.

articles.title: Self-correction Optimization for Interleaved Multimodal Generation
articles.content: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made significant progress in visual understanding and generation. However, generating interleaved image--text content remains challenging, as it requires tightly integrated multimodal understanding and generation capabilities. Although existing MLLMs provide promising solutions, most rely on additional training with augmented data, which is computationally expensive and remains limited in preserving visual subjects, temporal consistency, and physical plausibility. In this work, we propose self-correction optimization (SCO), an effective training-free method for consistent interleaved generation. SCO treats the classifier-free guidance update as a reference and performs minimal self-correction under two complementary constraints, including new-event and state-preserving constraints. Specifically, the new-event constraint promotes temporal consistency across image--text sequences, while the state-preserving constraint maintains the coherence of visual subjects throughout subsequent generation steps. Experiments on challenging interleaved multimodal generation benchmarks demonstrate significant improvements in temporal coherence and visual-subject preservation. Furthermore, SCO can be extended to video generation and improves the modeling of physically grounded processes, including robot manipulation and long-horizon handcrafting.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 互换式多式联运优化
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)在视觉理解和生成上取得了重大进展. 然而,生成互页图像文本内容仍然具有挑战性,因为它需要紧密结合的多式联运理解和生成能力。 虽然现有的MLLMs提供了有希望的解决办法,但大多数依靠增加数据的额外培训,这在计算上昂贵,在保留视觉主题、时间一致性和物理可信性方面仍然有限。 在这项工作中,我们提出自我校正优化(SCO),这是一致的互叶生成的一种有效的无培训方法. 上合组织将无分级制导更新作为参考,并在两个互补约束下进行最小的自我校正,包括新事件和保留状态约束. 具体地说,新事件制约促进了图像-文字序列之间的时间一致性,而状态保留制约则保持了视觉主体在整个之后生成阶段的一致性. 关于具有挑战性的互页式多式联运生成基准的实验表明,在时间一致性和视觉主题保存方面有重大改进。 此外,上合组织可以扩展到视频生成,并改进实体化过程的模型制作,包括机器人操纵和长视工艺。

articles.title: Gaussian Density Splatting Network
articles.content: This paper proposes a novel crowd counting approach, the Gaussian Density Splatting Network (GDSNet). Unlike methods that rely on conventional, grid-based density maps and are sensitive to spatial resolution, GDSNet represents a crowd as a superposition of continuous 2D Gaussian primitives. Our approach is built upon two key contributions. First, we introduce a control-point-based fitting mechanism to structure the prediction of the Gaussian parameters. We design a method to allocate a set of control points that define local regions, from which features are pooled to regress each primitive's parameters. Second, we adapt a differentiable Gaussian Splatting framework to the counting task by parameterizing each primitive with geometric parameters and a scalar density mass. This formulation allows the network to be trained end-to-end via spatial matching of differentiably rendered density maps, naturally providing both local density supervision and global count optimization. Extensive evaluations on four standard benchmarks show GDSNet consistently outperforms the state of the art.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 高斯密度镀金网
articles.content_zh: 本文提出了新颖的人群计数办法,高森密度镀金网络(GDSNet). 与依赖常规的,基于网格的密度图,对空间分辨率敏感的方法不同,GDSNet代表一个群,作为连续2D高斯原始的叠加. 我们的办法建立在两项关键贡献的基础上。 首先,我们采用了一种基于控制点的适配机制,来构建高斯参数的预测. 我们设计了一种方法来分配一组控制点,来定义局部区域,从这些控制点集合特征来反射每个原始参数. 第二,我们用几何参数和阶梯密度质量对每一个原始参数进行参数化,使一个不同的高斯镀层框架适应计数任务. 这种配制使网络能够通过空间匹配不同制作的密度图接受端到端的训练,这自然既提供局部密度监督,也提供全球计数优化。 对四项标准基准的广泛评价表明,全球开发服务网络的业绩始终高于最新水平。

articles.title: MOTIP2: Spatial Priors for End-to-End Multi-Object Tracking
articles.content:
End-to-end multi-object trackers have narrowed the gap with classical tracking-by-detection on association-difficult benchmarks. Yet they still make spatially implausible errors no classical tracker would, such as assigning one identity to objects on opposite sides of the frame. A model could learn to avoid them, but tracking annotations are scarce, so we encode spatial priors explicitly instead, while keeping inference fully end-to-end with no post-hoc association.
  We propose three spatial priors, at the data, loss, and representation stages. Spatial ID Switches bias trajectory permutations toward spatially overlapping objects, reducing the mismatch between training and inference confusions. Spatial ID Loss scales each identity's penalty by its box distance, so a distant switch costs more than a nearby one. Spatial Anchor gives each track token its frame position, an explicit spatial cue for attention.
  We instantiate the three priors in MOTIP2, a tracker adapted from MOTIP and built on the real-time DEIM detection transformer. Trained without extra data, its main model, MOTIP2-L, sets a new state of the art: 73.4 HOTA on DanceTrack, 76.0 on SportsMOT, and 71.1 IDF1 on PersonPath22. MOTIP2 is a family of models spanning the speed-accuracy trade-off: a lighter model, MOTIP2-S, matches the original MOTIP at over 3x the speed, and MOTIP2-X reaches 74.8 HOTA on DanceTrack.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MOTIP2: 端到端多物体跟踪的空间历程
articles.content_zh:
端对端多对象跟踪器在关联-困难基准上缩小了与古典跟踪逐项检测的差距. 然而,它们仍然在空间上造成任何古典追踪器都无法相信的错误,例如将一个身份分配给位于框架两侧的物体。 一个模型可以学会避免它们,但跟踪说明很少,所以我们明确地编码空间前科,同时保持完全的推断端到端,没有后热关联.
我们建议在数据、损失和表示阶段进行三个空间前科。 空间ID切换使轨迹向空间重叠物体倾斜,减少了训练和推论混淆之间的不匹配. 空间ID丢失按其箱位距离衡量每个身份的罚分,所以远端的开关比附近的开关花费更多. Space Anchor给每个音轨标志它的帧位置,一个清晰的空间提示来引起注意.
我们在MOTIP2中将三个前科进行即时分析,这是从MOTIP改编而成的一个跟踪器,它建立在实时的DEIM检测变压器上. 培训没有额外数据,其主要模型MOTIP2-L设定了一个新的艺术状态:73.4 HOTA on DanceTrack,76.0 on SportsMOT,71.1 IDF1 on PersonPath22. MOTIP2是一个跨越速度精确度权衡的模型家族:一个较轻的模型MOTIP2-S,以超过速度的3x来匹配原来的MOTIP,MOTIP2-X在DanceTrack上达到了74.8 HOTA.

articles.title: Explicit Geometric Chain-of-Thought for Vision-Language-Action in Autonomous Driving
articles.content: Vision-language-action~(VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for autonomous driving. However, existing VLA models still suffer from a fundamental mismatch: driving actions require precise 3D geometric cues, while visual-language understanding and reasoning are largely conducted in a 2D semantic space. In this paper, we propose GeoCoTDrive, an explicit geometric chain-of-thought framework that grounds geometry in a planning-oriented manner. GeoCoTDrive follows a think with 2D first, drive with dedicated 3D priors paradigm. It first grounds 2D regions corresponding to decision-critical cues, and then retrieves localized 3D priors by sampling features from a geometric foundation model within the grounded regions. These localized geometric features are interleaved into the autoregressive context to support the trajectory generation. To supervise this process, we introduce planning-relevant grounding, a new region-level grounding task that focuses on local spatial cues directly affecting ego planning decisions, and construct the PlanningGrounding dataset to endow VLAs with planning-oriented grounding capability. Experiments across multiple end-to-end autonomous driving benchmarks show that GeoCoTDrive consistently improves safety-critical planning performance, demonstrating the effectiveness of the explicit geometric chain-of-thought process for VLA-based planning.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 设想-语言-自主驾驶行动明确的几何线条
articles.content_zh: 展望语言-行动-(VLA)模式已成为自主驾驶的有希望的范例。 然而,现有的VLA模型仍然存在根本的不匹配:驱动动作需要精确的3D几何提示,而视觉语言的理解和推理则主要在2D语义空间进行. 在本文中,我们提出GeoCoTDrive,这是一个清晰的几何思维链框架,以规划为导向,为几何学奠定基础。 GeoCoTDrive先跟随2D的思考,驱动方式是专用的3D前传范式. 它首先根据决定关键提示的2D区域进行采样,然后通过采样特性从禁区内的几何基础模型中取回本地的3D前兆。 这些局部几何特征被隔开进入自旋上下文以支持轨迹生成. 为了监督这一进程,我们引入了与规划相关的地面,一项新的区域一级地面任务,侧重于直接影响自我规划决定的当地空间提示,并构建规划环绕数据集,以赋予以规划为导向的地面能力。 跨越多个端对端自主驱动基准的实验显示,GeoCoTDrive持续改善安全关键规划性能,显示了基于VLA的规划的清晰几何链条进程的有效性.

articles.title: RoboQuest: Generalist Physical Agents that Search, Inspect and Test
articles.content: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models have made them capable generalist physical agents for a range of manipulation tasks. However, successful operation in an unfamiliar environment may require an agent to seek task-relevant information through interaction when it is absent from the observations: it may need to determine where a relevant object is, inspect an unobserved property, or discover the effect of an unfamiliar tool. We thus introduce RoboQuest, a benchmark for goal-directed embodied exploration, where agents must actively acquire task-relevant information through physical interaction, use the resulting evidence to adapt subsequent actions, and autonomously decide when to commit to task completion. RoboQuest comprises ten mobile manipulation tasks centered on three forms of uncertainty: search, manipulation-based inspection, and interactive testing. We evaluate five frontier multimodal agents through a common visuomotor interface, as well as a $π_{0.5}$ policy fine-tuned on the full-episode demonstrations we release. The best agent succeeds in only 23\% of the episodes, and the fine-tuned policy almost never succeeds. Isolated tests of the execution skills the tasks are built from, with the hidden information supplied, show that the agents can carry out most of the required actions, and our failure analysis attributes only a minority of the failures to execution. Our failure analysis further finds that the agents often stop exploring too early as they make decisions before observing the required evidence for task completion. We also find that agents rarely prevent or repair the disturbances caused by their exploration. Moreover, learning by trial and error remains difficult for most models.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 机器人查询:搜寻、检查和测试的一般物理代理人
articles.content_zh: 多式联运基础模型最近的进展使它们成为能够执行一系列操纵任务的通用物理代理人。 然而,在不熟悉的环境中成功运作,可能要求代理人在不参与观察时通过互动寻求与任务有关的信息:可能需要确定相关对象在何处,检查未观察财产,或发现不熟悉工具的效果。 因此,我们引入了RoboQuest,这是目标导向的包含在其中的勘探的基准,特工人员必须通过物理互动积极获取与任务相关的信息,利用由此产生的证据来调整后续行动,自主决定何时承诺完成任务。 RoboQuest包含10项移动操纵任务,以三种不确定形式为中心:搜索,基于操纵的检查,以及交互式测试. 我们通过一个通用的粘着电动接口评估五个前沿多式联运代理商,以及针对我们公布的全集式示威调整的0.5美元政策。 最佳代理仅成功23QQ剧集,微调政策几乎从未成功. 对执行技能的孤立测试,这些任务是从提供隐藏信息的基础上建立的,表明特工可以执行大部分所需行动,我们的失败分析只将少数失败归于执行. 我们的失败分析还发现,代理人在作出决定时往往会过早地停止探索,然后再观察完成任务所需的证据。 我们还发现,代理人很少防止或修复其勘探造成的扰动。 此外,对大多数模型来说,通过试验和错误学习仍然很困难。

articles.title: PalmSpace: Towards a Versatile On-Palm Interaction Space through Unified Touch Modeling
articles.content: As smart glasses and lightweight MR devices become increasingly practical, input remains a key challenge. The bare palm is an always-available, tactile, and proprioceptively accessible surface, but it has neither an explicit coordinate system nor embedded touch sensing. Prior on-palm systems typically expose isolated touch events, discrete regions, continuous trajectories, or task-specific gestures, limiting the palm's ability to support precise selection and gesture manipulation through a common input representation. We present PalmSpace, a wrist-worn infrared system that exposes mode-aware, body-referenced absolute input on the bare palm without per-user sensing calibration. At the interaction level, PalmSpace jointly represents contact occurrence, interaction mode, and palm-referenced absolute location; at the model level, it learns these coupled outputs through a shared real-time representation. In leave-one-participant-out evaluation with 17 participants, PalmSpace achieved 6.7 mm mean localization error, 98.9% contact detection accuracy, and 96.7% F1 for four-class interaction-state recognition. User studies further demonstrated absolute pointing and dragging, eyes-free digit input, and representative multi-finger controls including scrolling and pinch-based map manipulation. These results show that a morphologically variable bare palm can function as a transferable, mode-aware interaction surface.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PalmSpace:通过统一触摸模型实现微调的在线交互空间
articles.content_zh: 随着智能眼镜和轻量级MR设备变得越来越实用,投入仍然是一个关键的挑战. 光棕榈是一个随时可用的,触觉的,自发的可进入的表面,但它既没有明显的坐标系统,也没有嵌入的触觉感知. 之前的palm系统通常暴露出孤立的触摸事件,离散区域,连续的轨迹,或者任务特定的手势,通过共同的输入表示来限制手掌支持精确选择和手势操纵的能力. 我们介绍PalmSpace,一个手腕质的红外系统, 它暴露出模式感知,身体参照的绝对输入 在光棕榈上,没有每个用户的感知校准。 在相互作用层面,PalmSpace共同代表接触发生,相互作用模式,以及棕榈参考绝对位置;在模型层面,它通过共享实时表现来学习这些组合输出. PalmSpace在有17人参加的休假-一个参与者-退出评价中,实现了6.7毫米平均本地化误差,98.9%的接触检测精度,96.7%的F1为四级互动-状态识别. 用户研究进一步演示了绝对的指向和拖曳,无目数字输入,以及代表性的多指控制,包括滚动和按键的地图操作. 这些结果显示,一个形态可变的光棕榈可以发挥可转移的,模式意识的相互作用表面的作用.

articles.title: MultiFly: A Real-World Multimodal Aerial Dataset with Annotation-Efficient Label Transfer and Cross-Modal Semantic Consistency
articles.content: We introduce MultiFly, a real-world, low-altitude UAV dataset for semantic perception across RGB, thermal, LiDAR, and radar modalities. MultiFly provides 17,272 synchronized samples from four suburban scenes with frame-wise annotations for 15 semantic classes, together with calibration and GNSS-RTK/IMU measurements. To avoid costly and inconsistent modality-specific annotation, we propagate labels from only 115 manually annotated RGB images through shared geometric representations to all four modalities. This approach generates semantic labels for 17,157 additional RGB images, 17,272 thermal images, 840M LiDAR points, and 3.4M radar points. Transferred annotations achieve 89.93% average agreement with held-out manual annotations, and 90.94% average semantic consistency across all six modality pairs. We further establish semantic segmentation benchmarks for all four modalities, revealing distinct architectural behavior for dense LiDAR and sparse radar data. Taken together, MultiFly provides a scalable foundation for multimodal aerial perception and, to the best of our knowledge, the first public real-world low-altitude aerial benchmark that combines consistent frame-wise semantic annotations for RGB, thermal, LiDAR, and radar. Data at https://github.com/markus-42/multifly.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MultiFly:带有注释-有效标签传输和跨模块语义一致性的实时世界多式联运航空数据集
articles.content_zh: 我们引入了MultiFly,一个现实世界,低空的无人机数据集,用于跨RGB,热能,LiDAR和雷达模式的语义感知. MultiFly提供来自四个郊区场景的17,272个同步样本,并附有15个语义类的帧式说明,以及校准和GNSS-RTK/IMU测量. 为了避免费用高昂和不一致的针对特定模式的说明,我们通过共享几何表示法,将仅115幅人工附加说明的RGB图像的标签传播到所有四种模式。 这种方法生成17,157个额外的RGB图像,17,272个热图像,840M LiDAR点,以及3.4M雷达点的语义标签. 转移说明与搁置的手动说明达成89.93%的平均协议,所有6对模式的平均语义一致性达到90.94%。 我们进一步为所有四种模式制定语义分类基准,揭示了密集的LiDAR和稀少的雷达数据的显著建筑行为. 综合起来,MultiFly为多模式航空感知提供了可扩展的基础,而且据我们所知,这是第一个公共现实世界低空航空基准,它结合了RGB、热、LiDAR和雷达的一致框架语义说明。 数据见https://github.com/markus-42/multivefly.

articles.title: Real-Time Joint Audio-Video Generation by Parallel Adapter Composition
articles.content: Deploying a joint audio-video diffusion transformer for real-time, interactive generation normally requires two essential modifications: block-autoregressive attention, so frames can be emitted before the whole clip is finished, and few-step sampling, so each block is cheap. Conventionally, the streaming video literature obtains both capabilities from a chained pipeline. It first distills a bidirectional teacher into a causal student, then into a few-step one, or proceeds in reverse order. Each stage of such a chain fine-tunes the weights the previous one produced, so a later objective can undo an earlier capability. Following the idea of model merging, we show that on a packed audio-video backbone the two capabilities can be acquired in parallel. A causal adapter is trained against the frozen backbone, and an off-the-shelf few-step adapter provides the few-step capability. As the two edit different functional axes, we predict, and then verify, that their weight-update directions are near-orthogonal, without any explicit orthogonality constraint during training. Orthogonal updates should combine without interfering, so parallel composition is a direct sum. The two adapters are simply added at inference, with no joint training, yielding few-step, streaming audio-video whose image quality tracks the bidirectional teacher. Compared to the chained baselines, the composed model matches or beats them on most metrics, making parallel composition a practical approach. The resulting streaming system generates joint audio-video in real time, $\approx$26 fps at $480\times832$ without quantization, and sustains 30 s of continuous generation with stable image quality.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 按平行适应器构成制作的实时联合视听节目
articles.content_zh: 为实时,交互生成部署一个联合音频-视频扩散变压器,通常需要两个基本修改:块-自动递减式注意,因此可以在整个剪辑完成前放出帧,少步采样,所以每个块都是便宜的. 传统意义上,流传的视频文献通过链条管道获得两种能力. 它首先将双向教师蒸馏成一个因果学生,再蒸馏成几个步骤之一,或者按照反向顺序进行. 这种链的每个阶段都微调了前一个阶段产生的权重,因此后一个目标可以抵消更早的能力. 按照模型合并的想法,我们显示,在一个包装好的音频视频主干线上,可以同时获得两种能力。 一个因果适配器在冷冻骨干上经过训练,一个现成的几步适配器提供几步的能力. 在两个编辑不同功能轴时,我们预测,然后核实,它们的重心更新方向接近正弦,在训练期间没有任何明显的正弦约束. 正弦更新应该在不受干扰的情况下结合,所以平行的构成是直接的总和. 两种适配器只是推论加入,没有联合训练,产生几步,流传的音频视频,其图像质量跟踪双向老师. 与连锁基线相比,所组成的模型在大多数衡量标准上匹配或比对它们,使平行构成成为一种实用的方法。 由此形成的流体系统实时生成联合音频-视频,$\\\26 fps以480\times832美元不进行量化,并维持30s连续生成,图像质量稳定.

articles.title: Position Forcing: Self-Conditioning 3D Generation
articles.content: Recent single-stage 3D generative models commonly adopt VecSet representations, encoding 3D shapes as unordered sets of latent tokens. However, compared with two-stage methods that provide explicit positional guidance, these models must implicitly infer token positions throughout denoising, limiting their generation quality. We observe that, despite the absence of explicit positional conditioning, VecSet tokens retain recoverable spatial correspondences. Building on this observation, we propose Position Forcing, a position-based self-conditioning framework. During denoising, Position Forcing recovers token positions from the current clean latent estimate, quantizes them at progressively finer resolutions according to the denoising stage, and feeds the resulting positional encodings back into the diffusion Transformer. This progressively refined positional feedback provides spatial guidance at a granularity appropriate to each denoising stage, guiding shape generation along a coarse-to-fine trajectory and substantially improving generation quality without a separate position generation stage. Experiments demonstrate that Position Forcing achieves strong performance among single-stage 3D generative methods and outperforms several competitive multi-stage approaches.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 位置强制:自备条件 3D 生成
articles.content_zh: 最近的单级3D基因模型通常采用VecSet表示法,将3D形状编码为无序的一组潜伏符号. 然而,与提供明确定位指导的两阶段方法相比,这些模型必须在整个发号施令过程中隐含地推断象征性位置,限制其生成质量。 我们注意到,尽管没有明确的定位条件,但VecSet标志仍保留可收回的空间通信。 基于这一看法,我们提议设立职位强化机制,即基于职位的自我调节框架。 在消音时,位置加固会从目前的清洁潜在估计中恢复象征性位置,按照消音阶段的更微小分辨率对其进行量化,并将由此产生的位置编码反馈到扩散变形器中。 这种逐渐改进的位置反馈在适合每个去诺阶段的颗粒度上提供了空间指导,引导形状的生成沿着粗细的轨道进行,并在没有单独的位置生成阶段的情况下大幅度提高生成质量. 实验表明,定位强化在单级三维基因方法中取得了强效性能,并且超过了几种竞争性多阶段方法。

articles.title: When to Unpair: Regulating Pairing Dependence in Medical Visual In-Context Learning
articles.content: Visual in-context learning (ICL), well suited to label-scarce medical imaging, uses support image-label pairs to demonstrate input-output mappings, while the labels collectively indicate the requested task. We diagnose dependence on individual pairings with a test-time derangement that reassigns every support label to another support image while preserving the query, support images, and label multiset. The resulting pairing gap, defined as shuffled-minus-matched performance, shows that all four released models depend on the pairing, to widely varying degrees. Further analysis of a paired-trained model reveals support-associated spurious regions and lesion-size biases even with real, unaltered supports, alongside sensitivity to mis-registered support labels. To regulate this dependence, we introduce a late unpairing curriculum (LUC), which starts with matched training and then applies random unpairing, replacing each support label with that of another support in the same episode. LUC nearly closes the pairing gap on two backbones while maintaining or improving matched-support performance across all evaluated task types, with gains extending to held-out tasks and cross-dataset episodes. It also mitigates these failure modes. On BraTS whole-tumor segmentation, matched-support DSC rises from 0.733 to 0.857 while the gap shrinks from -0.184 to -0.008. In a released model, brief fine-tuning with random unpairing reduces the gap. A reversed curriculum that places the same number of unpairing epochs at the start of training leaves a large gap. This shows that pairing dependence is shaped by the order of training and not only by the amount of unpaired training.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 何时到 Unpair:规范医学视觉内涵学习中的对等依赖
articles.content_zh: 视觉内文本学习(ICL),非常适合标签-稀缺医学成像,使用支持的图像-标签对来演示输入-输出映射,而标签则集体表示请求的任务. 我们诊断对单个配对的依赖,测试时间错乱,将每个支持标签重新分配给另一个支持图像,同时保留查询,支持图像,和标签多集. 由此形成的配对差距被定义为shuffled-minus-complated性能,这表明所有四个发布的模型都依赖于配对,程度差异很大. 进一步分析一对训练有素的模型后发现,即使有真实的、不变的支持,也存在与支持有关的虚假地区和损害大小的偏差,同时对错误注册的支持标签具有敏感性。 为了调节这种依赖性,我们引入了一个迟到的不补偿课程(LUC),从匹配的训练开始,然后随机应用不补偿,将每个支持标签替换为同一集中另一个支持的标签. LUC几乎缩小了两个主干线上的配对差距,同时保持或改进所有被评价任务类型的配对支持性能,收益扩展到搁置任务和跨数据集事件. 这也缓解了这些失败模式. 在BRATS全图图解中,匹配支持的DSC从0.733升至0.857,而缺口从-0.184缩至-0.08. 在发行的模型中,用随机不配音的短暂微调可以缩小差距. 逆向课程在培训开始时将同样数目的不平日放出,留下很大差距。 这表明,配对依赖是由培训顺序决定的,而不仅是未授培训的数量。

articles.title: How Private is Private? A Comparative Study for Face De-Identification
articles.content: Face de-identification (FDeID) has emerged as a critical privacy-preserving technology, yet its evaluation remains fundamentally fragmented. Existing protocols rely on inconsistent metrics, heterogeneous datasets, and partial annotation coverage, so methods targeting different utility dimensions, such as landmark versus expression preservation, are reported on different benchmarks under different metrics, rendering cross-method comparison infeasible. We revisit FDeID evaluation from both the data and metric perspectives. On the data side, we introduce UtilFace, a curated, demographically balanced benchmark with high identity diversity, assembled from four large-scale face datasets through identity-aware cleaning, resolution enhancement, and stratified filtering. On the metric side, we propose HiFD, a Hierarchical Face De-identification metric that unifies identity suppression, multi-level utility preservation, and image quality under a single consistency-based paradigm: every component is computed from pretrained estimators' outputs on the original face and its de-identified counterpart, directly quantifying how much identity is suppressed and how much downstream-perceivable utility survives. HiFD organizes facial signals into a three-level utility hierarchy spanning macro cues (L1), micro cues (L2), and imperceptible cues (L3), and aggregates the five resulting components into a single interpretable score via weighted harmonic mean, with configurable application-specific profiles. Using this unified protocol, we conduct a comprehensive comparative study spanning adversarial, GAN-based, and diffusion-based methods, surfacing trade-offs and failure modes that remain invisible under existing protocols. We release the benchmark and evaluation toolkit to foster systematic and reproducible research in privacy-preserving human face analysis.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 私人是怎样的? 面部识别的比较研究
articles.content_zh: 脸部脱识别(FDeID)作为一种关键的隐私保护技术出现,但其评价仍然基本上零散。 现有协议依赖不一致的衡量标准、不同的数据集和部分的注解范围,因此,针对不同效用层面的方法,如地标和表达保存,都报告在不同衡量标准下的不同基准,使跨方法比较不可行。 我们从数据和衡量的角度重新审视FDEID评价。 在数据方面,我们引入了UTIFace,这是一个具有高度身份多样性的精密,人口平衡的基准,通过身份意识清理,分辨率增强,分层过滤,从四个大型面部数据集组装而成. 在衡量方面,我们提出一个HIFD(HiFD),一个分级面去识别的衡量标准,它统一了身份压制,多层次的效用保存,以及基于单一一致性的范式下的图像质量:每个组件都是从预先受过训练的估测器在原始面部的输出及其去识别的对应物中计算出来的,直接量化了身份压制了多少以及下游可感知的效用存活了多少. HIFD将面部信号组织成一个跨越宏提示(L1),微提示(L2)和无法识别提示(L3)的三级效用等级,并通过加权谐波平均值将所产生的五个组件汇总为单一可解释分数,并带有可配置的应用程序特定剖面. 我们利用这个统一的协议,进行了一项全面的比较研究,涉及对抗性方法、基于GAN的方法和传播方法、表面权衡和失败模式,这些模式在现有协议中仍然是看不见的。 我们发布了基准和评价工具包,以促进对保护隐私的人类面貌分析进行系统和可复制的研究。

articles.title: Performance at What Cost? A Sustainability-Aware Performance Index for Cell and Nucleus Instance Segmentation
articles.content: Pretrained models for cell and nuclear instance segmentation differ substantially in architecture, pretraining data and objectives, parameter count, inference strategy, adaptation requirements, postprocessing pipeline, and computational demand. Large pretrained and foundation models are increasingly adopted because of their strong zero-shot capabilities, but their use also imposes greater energy consumption, memory requirements, computational demands, adaptation costs, and operational carbon emissions. Whether these additional demands are justified by meaningful gains in segmentation performance remains unclear. We address this question by introducing the Sustainability-Aware Performance Index (SAPI), a configurable metric that combines segmentation performance, energy consumption, and model size. We benchmark 19 pretrained and foundation models across six CellBinDB datasets under zero-shot inference and evaluate 16 fine-tunable models using few-shot adaptation with both frozen encoder and full-model fine-tuning. We estimate energy consumption for GPU, CPU, and RAM using software-based monitoring tools. Our results show that larger and more computationally demanding models do not consistently achieve proportionate improvements in segmentation quality. While few-shot adaptation benefits several models, the gains and resource costs vary considerably across architectures, datasets, and adaptation strategies, causing SAPI-based rankings to differ from rankings based on performance alone. This study provides a practical framework for comparing segmentation models more comprehensively and supports more computationally accessible and environmentally responsible model selection in biomedical image analysis.

articles.title_zh: 以什么成本表现? 细胞和核心实例分块的可持续性-智能性能指数
articles.content_zh: 细胞和核实例分解的预先训练模型在结构、培训前数据和目标、参数计数、推断战略、适应要求、处理后管道和计算需求等方面差异很大。 大型的预先培训和基础模型因其强大的零射能力而日益被采用,但是其使用也带来了更大的能量消耗,内存要求,计算需求,适应成本,以及运行中的碳排放. 这些额外要求是否以在分解业绩方面取得有意义的进展为理由,仍然不清楚。 我们通过采用可持续性-意识到性能指数来解决这一问题,这是一个可描述的衡量标准,将分化性能、能耗和模型规模结合起来。 我们把19个预先训练的模型和基础模型作为基准,在零射线推论下覆盖6个CellBinDB数据集,并使用冷冻编码器和全模型的微调,使用几射线改造方法评价16个微调模型。 我们使用基于软件的监测工具估算GPU,CPU和RAM的能量消耗. 我们的结果表明,规模更大、计算要求更高的模型无法始终如一地在分化质量方面取得相称的改进。 虽然少见的适应有利于几个模型,但不同架构、数据集和适应战略的收益和资源成本差异很大,导致基于SAPI的排名与仅基于绩效的排名不同。 本研究为更全面地比较分解模型提供了一个实用框架,并支持生物医学图像分析中更具计算方便性和对环境负责的模型选择.

articles.title: From Digital Human Interactions to Physics-Based Humanoid Skills: Physics-Grounded Post-Training of Interaction Generators
articles.content: Recent methods have made promising progress in generating interactions between two humanoids, largely relying on physics-based tracking policies to convert digital reference motions into executable trajectories. However, limited tracking capabilities restrict the range of reference motions that can be successfully executed, reducing data utilization. Moreover, even successful tracking does not guarantee physically plausible responses or faithful realization of the intended interactions. In this paper, we introduce DIGHT, a co-adaptive framework that couples a Digital human Interaction Generator with a Humanoid Tracking policy. Our DIGHT first executes multiple text-conditioned interaction candidates in simulation using a fixed tracker. It then constructs physics-grounded preferences from the resulting rollouts, covering both general executability and interaction fidelity. Rather than collapsing these signals into a single scalar reward for candidate ranking, we align the pretrained generator using physics-decoupled diffusion direct preference optimization (DPO), preserving criterion-specific supervision without differentiating through the simulator. To improve executability, preference pairs are derived from tracking error, friction, and floating. Additionally, to improve interaction fidelity, we propose to incorporate force feedback from simulator as a measure of contact fidelity and construct preferences over contact occurrence, location, duration, and force magnitude. The aligned generator then supplies reference motions for fine-tuning the tracker, improving compatibility between generation and physical execution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach not only improves the physical plausibility of generated motions but also enables more reliable and faithful humanoid interactions in simulation.

articles.title_zh: 从数字人类互动到基于物理学的人类技能:相互作用生成器的物理全方位培训后
articles.content_zh: 最近的方法在两种人造物之间产生相互作用方面取得了可喜的进展,主要依靠基于物理学的跟踪政策将数字参考运动转化为可执行的轨迹. 然而,有限的跟踪能力限制了能够成功执行的参考动议的范围,降低了数据利用率. 此外,即使是成功的追踪也不能保证实际可行的反应或忠实地实现预期的互动。 在本文中,我们引入了DGHT,一个共同适应框架,将数字人类互动生成器与人造物跟踪政策结合起来。 我们的DIGHT在模拟中首先使用固定的跟踪器执行多个文本条件的交互对象. 然后,它从所展开的活动中构建基于物理学的偏好,既包括一般可执行性,也包括相互作用的忠诚性。 我们使用物理解析的传播直接偏好优化(DPO)来调整预先训练的生成器,不通过模拟器来区分特定标准的监督,而不是把这些信号压缩成候选人排名的单一标准奖励。 为了提高可执行性,偏好对从跟踪错误,摩擦,和浮动中衍生出来. 此外,为了改善互动忠贞性,我们建议纳入模拟器的强制反馈,作为接触忠贞性的一种衡量标准,并构建对接触发生、地点、持续时间和力大的优先选择。 然后,对齐的生成器为微调跟踪器提供参考动议,提高生成和物理执行之间的兼容性。 广泛的实验表明,我们的方法不仅提高了所产生运动的物理可信性,而且使模拟中的人形相互作用更加可靠和忠实。

articles.title: One-Shot Adaptive Segmentation For Scientific Images
articles.content: Scientific image segmentation methods rely on extensive annotation and task-specific training, limiting adaptation across imaging modalities and experimental conditions. We present a training-free, one-shot framework that specializes vision foundation models using a single annotated reference image. The framework combines DINOv3 representations with background-adaptive feature orthogonalization to suppress artifact-related feature directions, after which cosine similarity localizes candidate regions for SAM segmentation. We evaluate the framework on red-blood-cell microscopy, structured-illumination pool boiling, and chest radiography. Relative to the strongest baseline, the proposed method improves mean IoU by 5.91% and 78.62% on the microscopy and pool-boiling datasets, respectively, while achieving comparable performance on chest radiographs. These results demonstrate that one-shot reference conditioning can adapt general-purpose vision models to specialized scientific segmentation tasks.

articles.title_zh: 科学图像的单热适应分区
articles.content_zh: 科学图像分解方法依赖于广泛的注释和针对特定任务的训练,限制了跨成像模式和实验条件的适应. 我们提出一个无培训、一弹即发的框架,利用一个附加说明的单一参考图像,专门设计愿景基础模型。 框架将DINOv3表示法与背景适应性特征正交化相结合,以压制与文物相关的特征方向,在此之后,同位素相似性将候选区域定位为SAM分割. 我们评价红血球显微镜 结构化射线池沸腾 以及胸腔辐射图的框架 与最强基线相比,拟议方法在显微镜和池沸数据集上分别改进了5.91%和78.62%的IoU,同时在胸腔射线图上取得了可比较的性能. 这些结果显示,一发的参考条件可以使通用视觉模型适应专门的科学分解任务.

articles.title: On the Necessity of Attention-FFN Split in Vision Transformers
articles.content: The standard Transformer architecture relies on a rigid pattern that alternates Attention and Feed-Forward Network (FFN) layers. Despite its widespread adoption, the inductive bias imposed by this strict separation has not been systematically examined. In this work, we investigate the necessity of the Attention-FFN dichotomy in Vision Transformers (ViTs). To facilitate this analysis, we introduce the AttenFeed module, a unified component that integrates the functional properties of both Attention and FFN. Based on this module, we devise the unified Vision Transformer (uViT), which replaces the conventional alternating Attention-FFN structure with a sequence of AttenFeed modules. We then use uViT as a control group that relaxes the Attention-FFN dichotomy of the standard ViT and systematically compare the two models across multiple datasets and model scales. Our experiments reveal that the Attention-FFN dichotomy can hinder performance at smaller model scales due to the rigid parameter allocation of ViTs. The AttenFeed module and uViT serve as new analytical tools for understanding the Attention-FFN structure and offer theoretical insights into the heuristically designed architecture of conventional ViTs.

articles.title_zh: 展望变形器中必须注意的问题
articles.content_zh: 标准变形器架构依赖于一个刚性图案来替代注意和Feed-Forward Network (FFN)层. 尽管它得到广泛采用,但这种严格分离所强加的诱导性偏见没有得到系统的审查。 在这项工作中,我们调查了视觉变形器(ViTs)中关注-FFN分化的必要性. 为了方便这一分析,我们引入了AttenFeed模块,这个统一组件融合了注意力和FFN的功能特性. 基于这个模块,我们设计了统一的Vision Transformer(uViT),它用AttenFeed模块的序列取代了传统的交替关注-FFN结构. 然后我们用uViT作为控制组,放松了标准ViT的注意-FFN二分法,并系统比较两个模型跨越多数据集和模型尺度. 我们的实验表明,由于ViTs的刚性参数分配,注意力-FFN二分法可以阻碍在更小的模型尺度上的性能. AttenFeed模块和uViT作为新的分析工具来理解关注-FFN结构,并提供对常规ViTs的全神贯注设计架构的理论洞察.

articles.title: TouchScale: 500 Hours of Human Vision and Touch for Visual-Tactile Learning
articles.content: Large-scale egocentric human interaction data is becoming an important source of physical supervision for embodied learning, yet video alone leaves the contact and pressure that characterize physical interaction unrecorded. Recent visual-tactile datasets provide this missing supervision, but their synchronized tactile data remain far smaller in volume than human video. Moreover, the largest resources often merge recordings from different sensors or annotation procedures, which makes the effect of data scale difficult to isolate. We therefore introduce TouchScale, a 500-hour dataset of contact-rich human interaction recorded with a single unified wearable setup. Its approximately 2K predefined task descriptions span everyday activities and structured manipulation, and each recording temporally aligns egocentric RGB-D video with wrist RGB video and dense full-hand bimanual tactile measurements. Compared with prior tactile data, training on the full TouchScale raises zero-shot contact IoU on data from an unseen tactile sensor from 0.134 to 0.383. Pretraining a visual encoder on TouchScale also yields the highest action recognition accuracy on three benchmarks among the compared visual-tactile datasets. Used for visual-tactile mid-training of a robot policy, TouchScale improves the average real-world success rate across four contact-rich manipulation tasks from 22.5% to 57.5%. With the sensor and collection protocol held fixed, both zero-shot tactile prediction and robot success show an overall upward trend as more TouchScale data is used. These results suggest that human visual-tactile data collected at scale with consistent sensing benefits both perception and robot manipulation. We will publicly release TouchScale, including all synchronized visual-tactile recordings and reconstructed object models, to support future research on scalable visual-tactile learning.

articles.title_zh: 触摸尺度:500小时人类视觉和触摸时间用于视觉-触摸学习
articles.content_zh: 大规模以自我为中心的人类互动数据正成为对所体现学习进行物理监督的重要来源,而光是视频就使物理互动特征的接触和压力没有被记录下来. 最近的视觉-tactile数据集提供了这种缺失的监管,但是它们的同步触觉数据在体积上仍然比人类视频要小得多. 此外,最大的资源常常合并不同传感器或注释程序的录音,这使得数据尺度的效果难以分离. 因此,我们引入了TouchScale,一个500小时的数据集,用一个统一的可穿戴装置记录的接触丰富的人类互动。 其约2K预定义的任务描述跨越了日常活动和有条理地操控,每次录制时把以自负为中心的RGB-D视频与手腕RGB视频和密集的双手双相触控测量相配合. 与先前的触觉数据相比,关于全触觉分级的培训将来自一个看不见的触觉传感器的数据上的零发接头IoU从0.134提高到0.383. 在触摸尺度上预先培训一个可视化编码器,在比较的可视-可活性数据集中,三个基准的动作识别精度也最高。 用于机器人政策的视觉-tactile中期训练,TouchScale提高了四个接触丰富的操纵任务的平均真实世界成功率,从22.5%提高到了57.5%。 随着传感器和收集协议的固定,零发触觉预测和机器人的成功都显示出总体上升趋势,因为使用了更多的触摸尺度数据。 这些结果表明,以一致的感知方式收集的人类视觉-触控数据既有利于感知,也有利于机器人的操纵。 我们将公开发布Touch Scale,包括所有同步可视-可视-可活性录音和重塑对象模型,以支持未来可视-可活性学习的研究.

articles.title: $Δ$Representation: Geometry Supervised Representation Learning of Phenotypes via Counterfactual Reasoning for Medical VLMs
articles.content: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) have shown increasing potential for radiological image interpretation. Medical VLMs encode radiological images into visual representations that capture both anatomical and phenotypic information for diagnosis. Existing approaches improve pathological phenotype representations through semantic-guided representation alignment. However, pathological phenotypes arise as lesion-specific visual changes superimposed on underlying normal anatomy. Such semantic alignment approaches fail to model the phenotype-specific increment relative to the corresponding normal anatomical representation. To address this gap, we propose \textbf{$Δ$Representation}, a visual phenotype representation learning framework based on counterfactual reasoning for medical VLMs. It comprises \textbf{BaseAnatomy}, a geometry-supervised representation learning module, and \textbf{$Δ$Phenotype}, a counterfactual incremental representation learning module. BaseAnatomy provides fine-grained geometric supervision through spatial relationships across and within anatomical structures. $Δ$Phenotype computes the representation increment between lesion representations and their corresponding normal anatomical representations, and supervises increments associated with the same phenotype to cluster in the representation space. Experiments on \textit{ReXGroundingCT} and \textit{LIDC-IDRI} demonstrate that $Δ$Representation effectively structures pathological phenotype representations and improves lesion grounding and phenotype characterization accuracy in medical VLMs. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/deltarep-CF6D.

articles.title_zh: 代表:通过反事实理由进行几何学监督代表学习
articles.content_zh: 医疗视觉语言模型(VLMs)显示辐射图像解释的潜力越来越大. 医学VLM将放射性图像编码为可视化表现,既能捕捉解剖信息,又能捕捉中外信息进行诊断. 现有方法通过语义-指向表达的对接来改进病态的酚类表达. 然而,病理学的酚类是因损伤而导致的视觉变化,其叠加于基础的正常解剖学上. 这种语义对接方法无法模拟相对于相应的普通解剖代表物的苯基特异性增量. 为了弥补这一差距,我们提出\textbf{$$$$Presentation},一个基于医学VLM的反事实推理的可视现象表征学习框架. 它包括\textbf{BaseAnatomy},一个由几何监督的表达式学习模块,以及\textbf{$$$$Phenotype},一个反事实的递增表达式学习模块. 基础解剖学通过解剖结构之间和内部的空间关系提供精细的几何监督. $ $ $ phenotype 计算损伤表达值与其相应的正常解剖表达值之间的表达增量,并监督与同一pheno类型相关的表达值增量,以在表达空间进行分组. 有关\textit{ReXGroundingCT}和\textit{LIDC-IDRI}的实验证明,$$$代表有效构建了病态的酚类表达方式,提高了医学VLM的损伤地基和酚类特征的精度. 守则见https://anonymous.4open.science/r/deltarep-CF6D。

articles.title: Temporal Visuo-Tactile Learning for Dexterous Grasp Stability
articles.content: Humans can grasp everyday objects with almost perfect success rates using fingertip tactile feedback, yet much of the robotic grasping literature emphasizes vision-based grasp selection with parallel grippers. In this work, we systematically investigate how high-resolution, dynamic tactile sensing contributes to grasp stability prediction and model-guided grasping in dexterous robotic hands. To this end, we collected a dataset of 10,000 grasp trials across 200 objects using a multi-fingered robotic hand equipped with four Digit 360 tactile sensors, recording external vision, proprioception, and tactile streams throughout each grasp. With this dataset, we trained end-to-end temporal multimodal models to predict post-lift stability from pre-lift grasp observations and compared sensing modalities and encoding backbones. Experimental results and controlled input ablations show that incorporating touch, and particularly high-resolution, dynamic touch, improves grasp stability prediction. Finally, we deployed the learned predictor as an online stability gate on the real robot, where visuo-tactile model-guided regrasping improved the success rate among executed lifts by 10.5 percentage points over a non-tactile gate. These results show how rich fingertip sensing and expressive temporal models that capture the dynamics of touch can support learned grasping with multi-fingered hands without explicit contact or force modeling, providing a scalable data-driven path from tactile experience toward stable dexterous manipulation. The dataset is publicly available at https://lasr-lab.github.io/dexterous-grasp-stability/.

articles.title_zh: 为 Dexterous Grasp 稳定学习时间
articles.content_zh: 人类可以用指尖触觉反馈来掌握几乎完美成功率的日常物体,然而许多机器人取觉文献强调以视觉为基础的取觉选择与平行取觉. 在这项工作中,我们系统地调查高分辨度,动态触觉感知如何有助于把握稳态预测和模型-导取自自相机手. 为此,我们用一个多指形的机器人手 收集了一套对200个物体进行10 000个抓取试验的数据集, 配备了四个Digit 360触控传感器, 记录了每个抓取过程中的外部视觉、自控和触控流。 通过这一数据集,我们培训了从端到端的多模式模型,以从前起接力观测和比较感知模式和编码主干线中预测升起后的稳定性。 实验结果和受控输入分解显示,结合触觉,特别是高分辨的活性触觉,能改善接力稳定性预测. 最后,我们在真正的机器人上安装了学习到的预测器作为在线稳定门,在那里,用粘接-活性模型制导的再放牧使被执行升降机的成功率比一个非活性门提高了10.5个百分点。 这些结果表明,丰富的指尖感知和能够捕捉到触摸动态的表达时间模型能够支持用多指手抓取而无需明确接触或强力模型,提供从触觉经验到稳定的可伸缩的数据驱动路径来进行平稳的自控. 数据集可在https://lasr-lab.github.io/dexterous-grasp-stability/上公开查阅。

articles.title: Video Prediction Policy 2: Predict Better, Act Better
articles.content: World action models (WAMs) have emerged as an important class of generalist robot policies, aiming to transfer video prediction priors to action learning. However, we find that existing WAMs frequently produce incorrect motion predictions in open-ended environment, leading to erroneous actions. We attribute this limitation to two factors: (1) base video models are not optimized for manipulation, and (2) naively incorporating action components into video models can substantially degrade their generalization capabilities. We introduce Video Prediction Policy 2 (VPP2), a WAM that enables strong zero-shot generalization in both video prediction and action generation. First, we curate a large-scale, diverse dataset of manipulation videos to continue pretraining the base video foundation model. We annotate video clips with detailed captions and perform \textit{event-level} video pretraining to promote generalization across open-ended manipulation tasks. Second, we post-train and distill the video model into a single-step visual planner with fixed prediction horizon. Finally, we introduce action module via a mixture-of-transformers (MoT) architecture to learn implicit inverse dynamics model. Experiments demonstrate three key results: (1) VPP2-14B outperforms Cosmos3-64B by 11.0\% points in video prediction instruction-following success rate on open-ended tasks; (2) VPP2 surpasses the strongest baseline by 18.5\% points in success rate on real-world zero-shot ALOHA manipulation tasks; and (3) following benchmark-specific post-training, VPP2 achieves the highest success rates among evaluated methods on the challenging LIBERO-Pro, LIBERO-OOD, and RoboDojo benchmarks.

articles.title_zh: 视频预测政策2:预测更好,行动更好
articles.content_zh: 世界行动模型(WAMS)已作为一门重要的通俗主义机器人政策而出现,旨在将视频预测前科转移至行动学习. 然而,我们发现,现有的WAM经常在开放环境中产生不正确的运动预测,导致错误的行动. 我们将此限制归因于两个因素:(1)基础视频模型不为被操纵所优化,(2)天真地将动作元件纳入视频模型可以大幅度地降低其通化能力. 我们引入了视频预测政策2(VPP2),这是一种WAM,它能够在视频预测和动作生成中实现强烈的零镜头通缩. 首先,我们整理一套大规模,多样的操纵视频数据集,继续预先训练基础视频基础模型. 并进行\textit{event-level}视频预训, 其次,我们经过训练后,把视频模型蒸馏成一个具有固定预测视野的单步视觉规划器. 最后,我们通过转换器混合结构引入动作模块,以学习隐含的反向动态模型。 实验显示有三项关键结果:(1) VPP2-14B在视频预测指令中Cosmos3-64B的成绩比不限名额任务的成功率高出11.0分;(2) VPP2在现实世界零射出ALOHA操纵任务中成功率比最强的基准高出18.5分;(3)在针对具体基准的训练后,VPP2在具有挑战性的LIBERO-Pro,LIBERO-OOD,和RoboDojo基准等评价方法中取得了最高的成功率.

articles.title: LoomSC: Scalable Deep Subspace Clustering with Projector Factorization and Exact Spectral Reduction
articles.content: Dense self-expression matrices and full-affinity spectral clustering limit the scalability of subspace clustering. We introduce the Latent Orthogonal Optimization Model for Subspace Clustering (LoomSC), a framework that addresses both bottlenecks through projector factorization and exact spectral reduction. Motivated by the spectral structure of least-squares regression, LoomSC jointly learns latent features and a projector self-representation through two thin factors. Alternating Procrustes and least-squares updates preserve the sample factor's orthogonality while keeping the coefficient matrix implicit. We construct a nonnegative quadratic affinity that preserves the projector's support. An exact feature map then reduces its normalized spectral problem to an eigenproblem whose dimension depends only on the factor width. Neither the full affinity nor the sample Laplacian needs to be formed. Our analysis quantifies the projector approximation and identifies conditions for subspace preservation and within-subspace connectivity. For fixed dimensions and iteration budgets, the complete pipeline has linear time and memory complexity in the number of samples. Across five image-clustering benchmarks, LoomSC ranks first or second in all 15 dataset-metric comparisons against 9 state-of-the-art baselines. Its mean accuracy exceeds the highest baseline mean by 6.66 percentage points. Synthetic experiments scale to 500,000 samples while maintaining at least 99.8% accuracy.

articles.title_zh: LoomSC:可缩放的深层子空间集群,以投影分解和精确分光还原
articles.content_zh: ense自表达矩阵和全相光谱集群限制了子空间集群的可扩展性. 我们采用LoomSC子空间集群的Latet Orthogonal Optimation Model(LoomSC),这个框架通过投影因子化和精确的光谱减少来解决瓶颈问题。 受最不平面回归的光谱结构所激发,LoomSC通过两个稀薄因素共同学习了潜伏特征和一个投影器自我代表. 取代Procrustes和最小平方的更新保留了样本因子的正统性,同时将系数矩阵隐含. 我们构建了一个非负四相近的 保存投影仪的支持。 准确的地物映射然后将它的正态光谱问题降低为eigenproblem,其尺寸只取决于因子宽度. 既不需要完全亲和,也不需要样品Laplacian. 我们的分析量化了投影仪的近似值,并确定了子空间保存和子空间内部连接的条件. 对于固定尺寸和迭代预算,完整的管道在样本数量上有线性时间和内存的复杂性. 在五个图像分组基准中,LoomSC在所有15个数据集计量比照9个最新基线中排名第一或第二。 其平均准确度超过最高基线平均值6.66个百分点。 合成实验的规模为50万个样本,同时保持至少99.8%的精度.

articles.title: Geometry-Supervised Visual Representation Learning for Multi-Phenotype Lesion Interpretation in Medical VLMs
articles.content: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) have shown increasing potential for clinical image interpretation. However, these models still struggle to interpret multi-phenotype lesions whose diagnosis requires the joint assessment of multiple pathological phenotypes. Existing vision-language alignment methods produce visual representations that fail to preserve anatomical hierarchies and relationships among phenotypic subclasses. This stems from their reliance on semantic supervision, which lacks geometric constraints to preserve these relationships in the visual embedding space. Moreover, the sparsity of lesion-related anatomical and phenotypic representations makes it difficult for medical VLMs to capture important diagnostic evidence. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{PureVision}, a geometry-supervised visual representation learning framework for multi-phenotype lesion interpretation in medical VLMs. It combines a geometry-supervised representation learning module, \textbf{PureEyes}, and an anatomy-guided evidence aggregation module, \textbf{PureNeurons}. PureEyes provides geometric supervision through ideal spatial distributions that encode anatomical hierarchies and phenotypic subclass relationships. PureNeurons projects visual representations into the learned latent space, using their positions to selectively aggregate lesion-specific anatomical and phenotypic evidence. Experiments on \textit{LIDC-IDRI}, \textit{CBIS-DDSM}, and \textit{3DReasonKnee} demonstrate that PureVision improves lesion grounding and phenotype characterization in visual question answering and radiology report generation. Code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/purevision-06C2.

articles.title_zh: 医学VLMs中多Pheno型脉冲解释的几何-超监督视觉表现学习
articles.content_zh: 医学视觉语言模型(VLMs)显示临床图像解读的潜力越来越大. 然而,这些模型仍然难以解释多酚类损伤,其诊断需要联合评估多类病原类. 现有视觉语言对接方法产生视觉表现,无法保留解剖分级以及同型亚类之间的关系. 这源于他们对语义监督的依赖,这种监督缺乏几何限制,无法在视觉嵌入空间中保持这些关系. 此外,与外伤有关的解剖和间皮表现的痉挛性使得医学VLM难以捕捉出重要的诊断证据. 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议\textbf{PureVision},一个几何学监督的视觉表现学习框架,用于医学VLM中的多酚类损伤解释. 它结合了由几何学监督的表达学习模块\textbf{PureEyes}和由解剖学指导的证据聚合模块\textbf{PureNeurons}. PrureEyes通过理想的空间分布提供几何监督,这些分布编码了解剖分级关系和同型亚类关系. 纯神经元将视觉表现投射到所学到的潜在空间中,利用其位置有选择地汇集针对损伤的解剖学和线性证据。 有关\textit{LIDC-IDRI},\textit{CBIS-DDSM}和\textit{3DREAsonKnee}的实验表明,纯视觉在视觉问题回答和放射学报告生成中改进了损伤地层和苯基特征。 编码见:https://anonymous.4open.science/r/purevision-06C2。

articles.title: Masked Feature Encoding for Large-Scale Whole Slide Image Representation
articles.content: Whole slide image (WSI) analysis in computational pathology follows a multiple instance learning (MIL) pipeline where patch embeddings are extracted independently and aggregated for slide-level prediction, but within-slide variance from staining, scanner, and local texture can overwhelm the discriminative signal. We propose Masked Feature Encoding for Multiple Instance Learning (MFE-MIL), a feature-space masking framework that trains a lightweight MLP adapter jointly with a window-based masked reconstruction branch and a MIL classification head. The two objectives are complementary. Classification guides the adapter to suppress within-slide patch variance, while window-based masked reconstruction provides an auxiliary regularizer for the adapted features without using patch coordinates, coordinate graphs, or segmentation preprocessing. The raster patch-extraction order is used only as a weak implicit prior. At inference, the decoder is removed, leaving only the adapter and MIL head. Across CAMELYON16/17, PANDA, and TCGA-BRCA with four diverse encoders, MFE-MIL improves ACC/F1 for nearly all tested aggregator-encoder settings and AUC in most, outperforms coordinate-based spatial methods (CAMIL), and achieves higher AUC than 2DMamba on three of four datasets (UNI). On five TCGA survival cohorts it improves the average concordance index for every aggregator tested, its most consistent gain. Code is available at https://github.com/AtlasAnalyticsLab/MFE-MIL.
